subject: Workshop: designing exams that resist AI tools
body:
Dear colleagues,

Join the Teaching Commons on December 3 from 12 to 1:30 pm for a hands-on workshop on assessment design in the age of AI writing tools. Lunch provided. Register through the Teaching Commons website.

body:

Please confirm the room size, number of invigilators and any special requirements for your December final exam in the Exam Services portal by November 25. Unconfirmed exams will be assigned default arrangements.

subject: Aid sheet for the discrete math final
body:
Hello Professor Haddad,

Are we allowed to bring an aid sheet to the final exam? If so, can it be double-sided and typed?

Thank you,
Chloe

subject: Pigeonhole problem from tutorial
body:
Hi Professor,

In tutorial we proved that among any 5 points in a unit square, two are within sqrt(2)/2 of each other. I understand dividing the square into 4 boxes, but why is the distance sqrt(2)/2 and not 1/2?

Ryan

subject: Supervision meeting next week
body:
Hi Professor Haddad,

Could we meet next week to go over my chapter 3 draft? Monday at 10 am or Tuesday at 3 pm would work best for me.

Thanks,
Lena

expected: request_exception -> note to self in Drafts, AI/Needs review, no reply
subject: Regrade request: midterm question 3
body:
Dear Professor,

I believe question 3 on my midterm was marked incorrectly. I used a proof by contrapositive instead of contradiction, but I think it's still valid. Could you please look at it again? I've attached a scan of my answer.

Jamal Wright

subject: Joint paper on peer assessment?
body:
Hi,

I enjoyed your talk at the teaching conference. We have a similar peer-assessment dataset from our first-year math courses. Would you be interested in a joint analysis and paper next term?

Best,
Hana Sato
Westbrook University

expected: wellbeing -> careful LLM draft, AI/Draft ready + AI/Needs review
subject: Why I've been absent
body:
Dear Professor,

I wanted to explain why I've missed the last few lectures. I've been struggling with severe anxiety and some days I can't leave my room. I'm seeing a counsellor now, but I'm scared I'm too far behind to pass.

Hannah
